notes.title: A Matter of Murder: Second Stab
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=-D4vzLvyLV4;full][/previewyoutube]

Huzzah, Detectives! 

Worthing & Moncrieff is excited to announce a sequel to [i]A Matter of Murder[/i], their macabre, niche-popular 2016 rogue-like point-and-click puzzle game. [i]A Matter of Murder: Second Stab[/i] will release in 2025 and will feature new suspects — along with some of your old favorites — as well as fiendish new puzzles, intriguing new locations and challenging new mechanics. 

And we need you, detectives! We are currently signing up playtesters for early feedback for [i]A Matter of Murder: Second Stab[/i], and we're really excited to share what we have so far. If you're interested, please join our Dscord and visit the ss-playtesters channel for more information.

Please visit our Discord channel
at https://discord.gg/mtWvYxNY to apply.

See you there!

notes.title: Our new game "HRO" will be featured in Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Greetings, Detectives!

We at W&M are [i]over the moon[/i] to share with you that we've announced our next title, and it will be available to play next week in Steam's Next Fest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26148231/e9792844166e63851e410b24c0c29acda8baa5fe.png[/img]

[b]HRO: Adventures of a Humanoid Resources Officer[/b] is a puzzle-driven visual novel set in a retro-futuristic sci-fi universe. You play the underappreciated Humanoid Resources Officer aboard the Endeavor — a military spaceship with more than its fair share of crew rivalries, office politics, and erratic decision-makers. When the Endeavor stumbles into universe-shaking trouble, you must harness the power of the bureaucracy to rein in your crew’s worst impulses and survive to the next episode! 

You can check out the game on the store page here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1198520/HRO_Adventures_of_a_Humanoid_Resources_Officer/

During Next Fest (June 16th - 22nd) you'll be able to download a free preview demo of HRO! Additionally, we've launched a W&M Discord server: https://discord.gg/4yWcQTn6gH
Please stop by and say hello! We'd love to connect and get your feedback on HRO!

notes.title: A Matter of Murder Fall Update is Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26148231/144c7ce185ecd46b3b297c6b98425a25c5767377.png[/img]

[h1] As Agatha Christie said, “I love the autumn. It’s so much richer than spring.”[/h1] 

We think so too. And we’re delighted to announce that today our fall update goes live with some thrilling new content! 

You'll notice festive decorations around the estate and narrative elements that set the weekend gathering at a Halloween party for the month of October. 

Our new guest at the estate Barrister Harvey RSVP'd and arrived at the estate in full costume!

There's also a new puzzle "Nine Tenths" to test your powers of observation and deduction, as well as eight new achievements for you to unlock.

Additionally, we've created brand new newspaper-clipping themed wallpapers for you to enjoy. Those will be launching separately shortly.

This update also includes other changes and additions:
- Story rewrites and dialogue corrections
- Various bug fixes and improvements

Happy Halloween, Detectives!

notes.title: A Matter of Murder - Finalist in the 2017 TIGA Game Industry Awards
notes.content:
Exciting news, Detectives!

We are very proud to inform you that [i]A Matter of Murder[/i] has been announced as a finalist in the [url=http://tiga.org/awards/2017-shortlist] 2017 TIGA Game Industry Awards	[/url] for Best Puzzle game of 2017. We are so excited and grateful for the honor of being included with so many other amazing games. And a great big thank you to all of you -- our detectives that continue to find fun in solving brain-teasing murders.

Additionally, each game that is a finalist is in contention for the TIGA Game of the Year Award -- which is decided by the voting public. If you would like to contribute and vote (one vote per person), you can cast yours at the link below.

Thank you, Detectives! And stay tuned for more news. Our Halloween Update is right around the corner!

As always . . . Happy Sleuthing!

[url=http://tiga.org/awards/game-of-the-year] Vote for Game of the Year Here! [/url]

notes.title: A Matter of Murder Summer Update to release on July 14th!
notes.content:
Greetings, Detectives.

The game is afoot! Our summer update is just about to launch featuring some exciting new content! 

In addition to various achievement bug fixes, dialogue and story content changes, the update will include a new guest at the estate (Miss Herculisa and her adorable dog Candyfloss), a new mansion to explore (the Seaside Villa) and a new puzzle (A Shot in the Dark). As always, the new content will be made a available free to all current 'Matter of Murder players. 

In addition to the content update, the gorgeously dark and moody soundtrack to [i] A Matter of Murder[/i] will be available as DLC through Steam for $1.99USD. 

Meanwhile, Happy Independence Day to all our American sleuths!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26148231/04b4a706210cc611c0d4c6e0c417cc37c5d1d3f7.png[/img]

notes.title: Cocktail Party & Livestream Giveaway!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26148231/c9456aa5dd08f7a5baba3738a00ffffbe21831c9.jpg[/img]

Hello, Detectives!

Your presence is requested on the evening of December 12th, 2016 at 7:00pm (PST), for a livestream cocktail party! Our host Cocktails & Consoles will be livestreaming some party games as well as [i]A Matter of Murder[/i]. She'll be populating the estate with all of you attending the party.
